That ref-link ships TODAY on feats/knowledge-is-power-wizard (core-descriptions feats/knowledge-is-power-wizard.r = [{"label":"Recall Knowledge","key":"actions"}]) and that record is being hidden from the pickers in this batch, so without this row the surviving record loses a working link the player can click now. The value is that shipped array whole — descRefs is ONE field, and the kept record has none today. No effect-backfill.json row exists on feats/knowledge-is-power for any field (the only knowledge-is-power* row is feats/knowledge-is-power-wizard · edition), and no other b032 spec touches this category/id/field, so no supersedes: true is owed. 36 descRefs rows already exist in the overlay, e.g. familiarAbilities/accompanist.
